isolation: Each scenario creates its own claim(s)/policy rule via the API (claimDate in previously-unused month buckets 2034-07..2034-11 for the meals-cap flagging and approvals scenarios, distinct from every prior validation run) or deletes/recreates the policy rule it needs (no per-rule ownership exists, so DELETE /policy-rules/{id} immediately before a scenario that needs an absent rule, then recreate through the scenario's own interface as the When). Negative/absence assertions in expense-claims.feature and approvals.feature read a fresh GET/UI state rather than relying on total counts, since the test accounts carry years of leftover data from prior validation runs.
